Saans rule: for children under 5 the nearest EPA row read (6 to under 11 years) stands in, because no row for them was read
Saans rule: children (5 to 12) use the EPA row for 6 to under 11 years
Saans rule: teenagers (13 to 17) use the nearest EPA row read (11 to under 16 years)
Saans rule: adults (18 to 59) use the EPA row for 31 to under 41 years
Saans rule: older adults (60 and over) use the EPA row for 61 to under 71 years
